sentences.text: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act provides a legal guarantee for at least 100 days of unskilled wage employment in a financial year to every rural household.
The main objective is to enhance livelihood security in rural areas.
It aims to create durable assets and strengthen the livelihood resource base of the rural poor.
The scheme provides wage employment to enhance the purchasing power of rural households.
It also promotes social inclusion by providing opportunities for marginalized groups.
Eligibility is limited to adult members of rural households.
Households must apply for employment under the scheme.
The application process involves submitting a job card application to the local Gram Panchayat.
The timeline for employment is based on demand and availability of work.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.
State governments are responsible for the execution of the scheme at the local level.
The scheme is funded by the central government and state governments.
The Mahatma Gandhi NREGA is a demand-driven scheme.
It also includes provisions for the payment of wages within a stipulated time frame.
The scheme promotes transparency and accountability through social audits.
It encourages the participation of women by providing equal wages.
The scheme also includes provisions for skill development and training.
